text: 【邢自强最新研判：两万亿元存量财政托底经济 AI休整不改长趋势】针对本轮政策周期以及下半年经济、产业和资本市场走向，摩根士丹利中国首席经济学家邢自强给出系统性研判。他认为，本轮政策不会复刻2024年的全面宽松节奏，国内经济将延续典型的K型结构性分化特征。在其研判框架中，下半年稳增长的核心抓手来自可加快使用的两万多亿元财政余力，资金将重点向新基建与硬核科技领域倾斜。
text_en: [Xing Ziqiang's Latest Assessment: Two Trillion Yuan in Fiscal Reserves to Support Economy; AI Pause Does Not Change Long-Term Trend] Morgan Stanley Chief China Economist Xing Ziqiang offers a systematic assessment of the current policy cycle and the economic, industrial, and capital market outlook for the second half. He believes this policy round will not replicate the broad easing pace of 2024, and the domestic economy will continue to show typical K-shaped structural divergence. In his framework, the core driver of second-half growth stability comes from over two trillion yuan in rapidly deployable fiscal reserves, with funds tilted toward new infrastructure and hardcore technology.
